### Meet the Mayor

#### Jackie Hutchison

Welcome to Middleton where "Life is Better Here" is more than just a slogan. It is an invitation to get involved in our wonderful city! Whether it is attending city council meetings, or volunteering, your participation is encouraged and makes a difference. As a proud resident of Middleton it is my honor to be a positive voice for the community.
